description: If 'True', blocks Wi-Fi Direct (a direct, peer-to-peer connection between devices using Wi-Fi frequencies). If set to 'False', Intune doesn't change or update this setting. By default, the OS might allow Wi-Fi Direct. Available for fully managed, dedicated, and corporate-owned work profile devices.

options.description: The user is allowed to use Wi-Fi direct.
The user is not allowed to use Wi-Fi direct. A NonComplianceDetail with API_LEVEL is reported if the Android version is less than 13.
